To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the electromagnetic environment in the switch yard is more severe than which in relay room; (2) the electromagnetic disturbance signal of 500kV substation is stronger than that of 100kV substation; (3) the EMC standard is not enough for checking field installation secondary intelligent equipment; (4) the EMC performance of secondary intelligent device can be improved by adding filter and shielding.
the secondary intelligent device should be designed according to the EMC standard for field installation.
the electromagnetic environment in the switchyard of intelligent substation is much worse than that of relay protection room.
